# CaulHaus

> CaulHaus provides operations architecture and workflow automation to eliminate spreadsheet bottlenecks and connect cross-tool handoffs.

## Overview
CaulHaus is led by an operations architect and engineer with over a decade of cross-functional systems experience, including three years building operational automation systems within an extended network inside one of the largest technology enterprises in the world.

Most operational workflows fail during handoffs between disconnected software platforms and teams. CaulHaus engineers complete operational architecture: we diagnose bottlenecks, streamline processes, and develop automated scripts and integrations that allow teams to operate reliably without adding software subscription overhead.

## The Five Operational Pillars
CaulHaus structures all operational architecture across five core domains:

1. UX & Product Operations: We streamline design-to-development handoffs, centralize research repositories, and synchronize cross-functional project tracking across Jira, Linear, and Figma.
2. Vendor & Partner Management: We automate contract renewal alerting, contractor onboarding pipelines, and multi-currency invoice reconciliation workflows.
3. Marketing Operations: We deploy attribution plumbing, server-side tracking infrastructure, event taxonomies, and automated CRM lead routing pipelines.
4. Internal Capacity & General Automation: We eliminate brittle spreadsheets, automate capacity planning calculations, and deploy custom Google Workspace and Google Apps Script solutions.
5. Commercial & Revenue Operations: We engineer deal desk validation logic, CRM-to-billing synchronizations, and sales-to-finance handoff workflows.

## How We Engage (/services/)
1. Operations & Workflow Audit: A comprehensive diagnosis of operational bottlenecks, technical debt, and spreadsheet fragility with a prioritized architecture roadmap.
2. Workflow Automation Build: End-to-end design and deployment of custom automations, webhook bridges, and system handoffs across existing tools.
3. Ongoing Operations Retainer: Continuous systems engineering, proactive workflow monitoring, and integration maintenance as operational scale expands.

## Track Record & Operational Impact
- We engineered and deployed an enterprise resource planning and capacity system that onboarded 17 teams and 37 people on a single Google Apps Script architecture, recovering approximately 590 hours per month in saved manual status tracking.
- We eliminate recurring SaaS costs by building directly on top of your existing Google Workspace, CRM, and internal tool APIs.
